tasks.description: Compute hourly mean, min, max, and count for temperature_c and humidity_percent.
Detect anomalies via rolling z-score (e.g., window=5) for temperature_c and humidity_percent; flag points with absolute z-score above a threshold (default 3).
Flag sudden 5-minute jumps when absolute delta exceeds configurable limits (e.g., >0.7°C for temperature or >2.5 percentage points for humidity).
Fit a lightweight linear model on recent readings and forecast temperature_c and humidity_percent for the next 12 five-minute intervals (next hour).
Estimate dew point using a Magnus formula and flag potential condensation risk when dew_point >= configurable threshold (default 20°C).
Compute absolute humidity (g/m³) from temperature_c and humidity_percent to quantify moisture load independent of temperature.
Trigger alerts when temperature_c or humidity_percent exceed configurable comfort thresholds (e.g., temperature > 30°C or humidity > 65%).
Estimate linear slope over the last N samples for temperature_c and humidity_percent and classify as rising, stable, or falling using sensor-accuracy-based tolerance.
